title: thalictrum coriaceum
intro: Thalictrum coriaceum, commonly known as the wrinkled meadow rue, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Thalictrum coriaceum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
